_note: Preset library for the svg-character-animator skill. All durations in ms. Easing names map to easeFns in MorphAnimator.jsx.

snappy.description: UI feedback, button toggles. Front-loaded speed, soft landing.

gentle.description: Default. Symmetric, smooth, suitable for most content transitions.

bouncy.description: Playful overshoot. Pairs with playful aesthetic.

dreamy.description: Ambient, slow, no perceived boundary. Pairs with floating aesthetic.

icon-toggle.description: Short, sub-paths morph in unison. For two-state UI icons.

character-emotion-shift.description: Stagger by anatomical priority. Eyes lead, body follows.

ambient-loop.description: Slow, heavy stagger, no clear arrival moment.

playful.description: Slight overshoot at midpoint. Adds bounce and weight.

floating.description: Reserved for vertical drift and slight blur during morph.

_blend.description: During morph, idle amplitude ramps to minAmplitude over rampDurationFraction × morph duration, then back to 1.0 after morph. These specific numbers (0.4 / 0.1 / sine in/out) were tuned through iteration.

_pivot.description: Bottom-center pivot for all rotation/scale idle animations. Characters stand on ground; rotating around feet feels right.

sway.description: Gentle horizontal rotation. Pairs well with tree-like or grounded characters.

breathe.description: Uniform scale on slow loop. Calm, ambient. Always scales above 1.0 (never shrinks).

bob.description: Vertical translation upward only. For floating objects.

shake.description: Quick high-frequency wobble. Subtle by default (±1°); increase to ±3° for stronger reaction.

twinkle.description: Opacity + scale flicker on children with data-twinkle. Each child gets own random phase and slightly different period.

sway-twinkle.description: Combo: sway the whole character + twinkle decoration children. Used for stars/sparkles surrounding a swaying figure.

drift.description: Two-axis sine drift with incommensurate periods, so motion never exactly repeats. Reads as floating/dreamcore.
